source.name: ACE3 Artillery Table (exported from the game)

ammunition.description: HE rounds; smoke D-462 and illumination S-463 fly by the same table. HEAT BK-6M and BK-13 (direct fire) are not included.

default.notes: Exported from the game with web/tools/arma/export_tables.sqf (the same ACE extension computation as the in-game table), see web/data-sources. dElevPer100m and dTofPer100m are the in-game 'D ELEV PER 100 M DR' and 'TIME OF FLIGHT PER 100 M DR' columns: change per 100 m of height difference. This profile is without air resistance (weather columns empty); the advanced profile is with it and has the in-game weather corrections. A null value means the game table shows '-'.
